name: Nest Alpha Vault LP
oneLiner: inALPHA is Nest Credit's NAV-priced dollar vault token, holding private and structured credit positions with nTBILL and liquid stablecoin buffers.
collateral: Diversified portfolio of tokenized RWAs from institutional asset managers plus private-credit and trade-finance positions from accredited protocol partners, with a liquidity buffer of yield-bearing stablecoins and an nTBILL (Nest Treasury) allocation.
pegMechanism: Vault LP token whose value targets a dollar base but can appreciate or drift with strategy NAV rather than functioning as a hard 1:1 redeemable stablecoin

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Nest issues the inALPHA BoringVault natively on Ethereum and Plume at the same address under the same Nest 3-of-6 Safe (owner() read 2026-07-20); cross-chain share movement runs through Nest's own LayerZero OFT contracts (issuer-operated burn/mint, hub-and-spoke accounting). No third-party bridge carries the representation.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-2 (lead usdc-circle)

routes.reviewNote: Issuer-native deployment: the same Nest BoringVault is deployed on ethereum with owner() = the Nest 3-of-6 Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982 (on-chain read 2026-07-20); shares mint only through Nest's own Teller contract. No third-party bridge mints this deployment.

Issuer-native deployment: the same Nest BoringVault is deployed on Plume with owner() = the Nest 3-of-6 Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982 (on-chain read 2026-07-20). Cross-chain share movement between Plume and Ethereum runs through Nest's own LayerZero OFT contracts (NestVaultOFT/NestShareOFT hub-and-spoke per the nest-protocol repository and Nest cross-chain docs) — an issuer-operated burn/mint, not a third-party bridge; the share token itself is not the LayerZero OApp.

reserveReview.rationale: Mirrored the live Nest Alpha Vault positions API captured on 2026-08-08. The adapter buckets liquid stablecoins into tracked slices (USDC, pUSD) and nTBILL into the fund-share slice; all unclassified yield strategies (nOPAL, nFALCON, nLCRD, nCLOA, nACRDX) are grouped by the adapter under 'Nest private and structured credit vaults'. That aggregate slice is classified with assetClass private-credit and a concrete issuerOrObligor listing the strategy tokens, so no known-unknown exposure remains.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Nest Alpha Vault positions API snapshot
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Individual private-credit strategy weights are not itemized by the issuer beyond the token-level position values; the adapter's aggregate bucket is classified rather than decomposed.

notices.message: inALPHA is tracked because it references a dollar base, but the token behaves like a vault share rather than a pure par stablecoin.
